채용공고 상세

해외 영업
/ AI 헬스케어 기업

모집분야
1. 회사 소개
-
AI  기반 Surgical Platform 개발 헬스케어 기업
-  근무지 : 서울 마포구

2. 포지션 : 해외 영업
3. 주요 업무
-
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve international sales targets.
- Identify and establish relationships with potential overseas clients and partners.
- Conduct market research to understand global market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs.
- Negotiate and close partnership contracts with local distributors or sales agents
- Collaborate with the marketing team to develop promotional materials and campaigns tailored for international markets.
- Prepare regular sales reports and forecasts for senior management.
- Travel internationally as required to meet clients and attend industry events.
4. 자격 요건
-

Bachelor's degree
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in international sales in the medical device sector
- Proven track record of achieving sales targets and growing market share.
- Strong understanding of international markets and business practices.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Fluency in English; additional language skills are a plus.
🏠 근무조건
• 고용형태 : 정규직
• 급여 :
면접 후 결정
• 근무지 : 서울 마포구
